      logger.warn("Replacing 'provides' entry #{provides} with syntax 'name (= version)'")
      provides = "#{m[1]} (= #{m[2]})"

    # Debian package names must start with an alphanumeric character and may
    # contain lowercase letters, digits, '+', '-', and '.'. A versioned
    # provides entry may only use an exact version with '=', not inequalities.
    if !provides.match(/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9+.-]+(?:\s+\(=\s+[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.+~:-]*\))?$/)

        "Invalid 'Provides' entry '#{provides}'. Debian provides must be a " \

        "'foo (= 1.0.0)'"
    end

    return provides.rstrip
  end
